# Safe Haven Inspections LLC

> Independent, family-operated, Florida state-licensed mold inspection, testing, and
> indoor air-quality assessment serving Martin, Palm Beach, and Broward Counties in
> South Florida. Assessment and testing only, never remediation, so the company doing
> the testing never profits from the cleanup it recommends. Founded by Landon
> Heinrichs, a lifelong South Florida resident with 14 years of experience whose
> background is in mold remediation. Licensed as a Florida Mold Assessor (MRSA3366)
> and Mold Remediator (MRSR3536). Samples are analyzed by an independent
> AIHA-accredited laboratory and the written report is delivered within 24 hours.

Safe Haven is a mold assessor, not a home inspector, and does not hold or advertise a
Florida home inspector license. Inquiries about four-point or wind-mitigation
inspections are outside its scope.
